```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;

class TodoDetail extends Component
{
    public $todoId;
    public $title;
    public $completed = false;

    public function mount($todoId)
    {
        $this->todoId = $todoId;
        $response = Http::get("https://api.example.com/todos/{$todoId}");
        if ($response->status() == 200) {
            $data = json_decode($response->body(), true);
            $this->title = $data['title'];
            $this->completed = $data['completed'];
        }
    }

    public function updateTodo()
    {
        $response = Http::put("https://api.example.com/todos/{$this->todoId}", [
            'title' => $this->title,
            'completed' => $this->completed,
        ]);
        if ($response->status() == 200) {
            return redirect()->route('todos.index');
        }
    }

    public function deleteTodo()
    {
        Http::delete("https://api.example.com/todos/{$this->todoId}");
        return redirect()->route('todos.index');
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.todo-detail');
    }
}
```
